title: Code and data for: Trends, centre variation and in-hospital mortality of off-pump coronary artery bypass grafting in Brazil's public health system, 2003–2025
description: Analysis code, aggregated results and analysis plan for the article. The code downloads the public SIH/SUS hospital discharge files (DATASUS) and reproduces every table and figure. No record-level data are included; hospitals are not named.
